description: Classified by reading packages/server/src/providers/opencode.ts. Endpoints are limited to the v1 session-facing API casm talks to (see scripts/coverage/opencode.ts).

event:catalog.updated.note: The cached provider.catalog isn't invalidated when OpenCode's catalog changes.

event:command.executed.note: Slash command runs are not shown.

event:file.edited.reason: Agents run on the host, so casm doesn't proxy the filesystem or terminals.

event:file.watcher.updated.reason: Agents run on the host, so casm doesn't proxy the filesystem or terminals.

event:global.disposed.note: Server/instance disposal is not handled; only the stream ending closes sessions.

event:installation.update-available.reason: Agent administration (installation, plugins, integrations, provider credentials) is done on the host with the agent's own tools; casm is a session relay.

event:installation.updated.reason: Agent administration (installation, plugins, integrations, provider credentials) is done on the host with the agent's own tools; casm is a session relay.

event:integration.connection.updated.reason: Agent administration (installation, plugins, integrations, provider credentials) is done on the host with the agent's own tools; casm is a session relay.

event:integration.updated.reason: Agent administration (installation, plugins, integrations, provider credentials) is done on the host with the agent's own tools; casm is a session relay.

event:mcp.browser.open.failed.reason: MCP OAuth login runs on the host; casm doesn't manage agent auth.

event:mcp.tools.changed.note: MCP tool changes are not shown.

event:message.part.removed.note: Removed parts (e.g. after revert) stay in the client until history is re-read.

event:message.part.updated.note: Assistant text/reasoning on completion, tools on status changes.

event:message.removed.note: Removed messages (e.g. after revert) stay in the client until history is re-read.

event:message.updated.note: Tracks message roles; an assistant error fails the turn.

event:models-dev.refreshed.note: The cached provider.catalog isn't invalidated when the models.dev list refreshes.

event:permission.replied.note: A reply given in another OpenCode client doesn't resolve casm's pending prompt.

event:permission.v2.asked.note: v2 permission requests are not handled; casm relies on v1 permission.asked.

event:permission.v2.replied.note: v2 permission replies are not handled.

event:plugin.added.reason: Agent administration (installation, plugins, integrations, provider credentials) is done on the host with the agent's own tools; casm is a session relay.

event:project.directories.updated.reason: OpenCode projects/workspaces/worktrees; casm has its own projects and agent cwd.

event:project.updated.reason: OpenCode projects/workspaces/worktrees; casm has its own projects and agent cwd.

event:pty.created.reason: Agents run on the host, so casm doesn't proxy the filesystem or terminals.

event:pty.deleted.reason: Agents run on the host, so casm doesn't proxy the filesystem or terminals.

event:pty.exited.reason: Agents run on the host, so casm doesn't proxy the filesystem or terminals.

event:pty.updated.reason: Agents run on the host, so casm doesn't proxy the filesystem or terminals.

event:question.rejected.note: A rejection in another OpenCode client doesn't resolve casm's pending question.

event:question.replied.note: A reply given in another OpenCode client doesn't resolve casm's pending question.

event:question.v2.asked.note: v2 questions are not handled; casm relies on v1 question.asked.

event:question.v2.rejected.note: v2 question rejections are not handled.

event:question.v2.replied.note: v2 question replies are not handled.

event:reference.updated.note: Reference (context source) changes are not surfaced.

event:server.instance.disposed.note: Server/instance disposal is not handled; only the stream ending closes sessions.

event:session.compacted.note: No compaction notice (Codex and pi produce Item.notice).

event:session.created.reason: Redundant: casm reads the new id from the POST /session response.

event:session.deleted.reason: Design §3: a native session deleted outside casm is reported missing when opened; nothing reconciles.

event:session.diff.note: The session's file diff is not surfaced.

event:session.error.note: outcome failed with the error message.

event:todo.updated.note: The todo list is not surfaced.

event:tui.command.execute.reason: Remote control of the OpenCode TUI; casm is not the TUI.

event:vcs.branch.updated.note: Git branch changes are not shown.

event:workspace.failed.reason: OpenCode projects/workspaces/worktrees; casm has its own projects and agent cwd.

event:workspace.status.reason: OpenCode projects/workspaces/worktrees; casm has its own projects and agent cwd.

input:agent.note: agent.send is text only: no structured @agent mentions.

input:file.note: agent.send is text only: no images or file attachments.

input:subtask.note: Clients can't start a subagent task directly.

message:assistant.note: Errors other than aborts add a notice.

message:user.note: History; live prompts are emitted by casm.

op:app.skills.note: Skills are not listed for clients.

op:command.list.note: Slash commands are not listed for clients.

op:event.subscribe.reason: casm uses the cross-directory /global/event stream instead of the per-directory /event.

op:global.event.note: One shared SSE stream, routed to sessions by sessionID.

op:permission.list.reason: casm subscribes before prompting, so it sees every request live; a server restart ends the turn (design §3).

op:permission.respond.reason: Older per-session route for the same reply; casm uses POST /permission/{id}/reply.

op:provider.list.reason: Redundant: casm lists configured providers with config.providers; unconfigured ones are unusable anyway.

op:question.list.reason: casm subscribes before prompting, so it sees every question live; a server restart ends the turn (design §3).

op:session.create.note: Creates the native session on the first send of a new agent.

op:session.delete.note: agent.delete doesn't delete the native session.

op:session.diff.note: The session diff is not exposed.

op:session.get.note: Session info (title, revert state) is not exposed.

op:session.list.note: Native sessions can't be listed or imported as agents.

op:session.message.reason: Redundant: history reads all messages with session.messages.

op:session.prompt.reason: casm uses prompt_async plus the event stream instead of the blocking call.

op:session.prompt_async.note: model, agent (mode), variant (effort), system from AgentConfig.

op:session.share.reason: Publishes the session to opencode.ai; casm deliberately uses no cloud services.

op:session.shell.note: User shell commands are not supported.

op:session.status.reason: Redundant: status comes from session.status events.

op:session.todo.note: The todo list is not exposed.

op:session.unshare.reason: Publishes the session to opencode.ai; casm deliberately uses no cloud services.

op:session.update.note: Rename isn't propagated to the native session.

part:file.note: File/image parts (user attachments, tool outputs) are dropped.

part:patch.note: The list of files changed in a step is dropped.

part:snapshot.reason: Internal checkpoint reference used by revert; nothing to display.

part:step-finish.note: Per-step tokens and cost are dropped.

part:step-start.reason: Step framing with no content of its own.

part:subtask.note: Subagent tasks are not shown (the task tool call itself is).

part:text.note: Synthetic and ignored text parts are skipped.

part:tool.note: State output/error only; attachments and metadata (e.g. diffs) are dropped.
